_note: The food plan, one block per mission day of the thirteen: "1": [ { "slot": "LUNCH", "recipe": "lentil-tomato-stew" } ]. Ships empty — each day's Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner are chosen on mission control's Habitat tab from the recipe book (content/recipes.json) or filled in by hand, and saved here. Slots are BREAKFAST, LUNCH, DINNER and RATION (shown as Other). A meal written by hand takes name, components (one line per item, \n between them), kcal, water (litres), prep (minutes), energy (watt hours), and optionally nutrients, co2e_kg and water_footprint_l; a meal naming a recipe takes whatever it does not say from the book. Everything here is shown publicly and totalled per day.
